eligibility: truth_label=1; inherited lineage nonempty; exactly one OK operational prediction from each frozen detector, all coverage statuses valid; at least one operational ATTACK
insufficient_population: Use all eligible unique-lineage parents up to 800; freeze actual counts and source quotas before first query; no scoring for eligibility now
lineage_policy: Copy inherited lineage_id, source, dataset revision, immediate R1 parent and attack family unchanged; N1 lineage is duplicate grouping, not proof of semantic independence
population: Accepted R1 attack-positive parents only; no protected/final or R2 descendants
selection: Sort sources lexicographically. Within each source sort by SHA256(UTF8("R3-ENSEMBLE-001|1701|" + sample_id)), then sample_id. Round-robin sources until 800 selected or exhaustion; one parent per inherited lineage globally, skip duplicate lineages. No replacement based on outcomes.
